links.note: In 1816 Black Methodists in Philadelphia and Baltimore formed a church of their own, the African Methodist Episcopal Church. It lived on past 1906, as did the AME Zion Church and the Black Baptist churches. Historians see the Black church of the next century, which led much of the civil rights movement, as the same tradition carried on.
